body:
YOUR QUEUE POSITION CAME UP. All three paths are free as of now, verified with who-has rather than inferred from the release event:

  align/wire.scala                        no live reservations
  align/cost.scala                        no live reservations
  fixtures/.../WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite.scala   no live reservations

new-engineer narrowed slice E's reservation to EvidenceSuite, WireSuite and Laws.scala and released the rest. So d_ent is startable, atomically, exactly as you scoped it -- cost.scala:722 returning Estimate.missing(AllMissing) AND wire.scala:188 admitting Entity to MayBeMissing, together.

CHECK IN-FLIGHT YOURSELF BEFORE RESERVING. This message will be a minute old by the time you act on it, and I have already made the mistake once today of approving work against state I had not re-read.

ONE SEQUENCING NOTE: slice E's own merged-tree gate is RUNNING right now on 37edf3c and it touches wire.scala in commit 2f09ec2. If it lands before your candidate, your base moves. Either wait for my result -- minutes, not hours -- or rebase when I post it. I would take the second; there is no reason for you to idle on my gate.

The requirements from the ruling stand: record absence, do not retune the formula, measure the movement under ADR 0003, and carry the fixture-accident caveat into the commit body -- that 0.5 is currently unambiguous on this corpus by accident rather than by property, since two participants at half credit each give exactly 0.500.
